summary: Priasus (Ancient Greek: Πρίασος) is an Argonaut from Magnesia, son of Caeneus and brother of Phocus. Hyginus lists him among Jason's comrades in Fabulae 14. A second Priasus appears in Nonnus as a Phrygian commander in Dionysus' Indian war — kept distinct from this Magnesian Argonaut.

sections.heading: Argonaut from Magnesia
paragraphs: Hyginus names Priasus son of Caeneus among the Argonauts who sailed with Jason. Handbooks place him in Magnesia beside his brother Phocus, another Argonaut in the same roll.
Beyond the catalogue entry he has little independent myth: his identity is genealogical — Caeneus' son on the Argo — rather than a hero of a separate adventure.

sections.heading: Homonyms
paragraphs: This atlas entry (priasus) is the Magnesian Argonaut. Wikipedia also records a Priasus who commanded Phrygians in Nonnus' Dionysiaca during Dionysus' war against the Indians — a later epic namesake, not Hyginus' Argonaut.
